question: According to which Article of the Indian Constitution is the population census a Union subject?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Article 246__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Article 246** of the Indian Constitution, the **Population Census** is a **Union Subject**.
 
• **Article 246** deals with the **distribution of legislative powers** between the Union and the States.
 
• It establishes a three-fold distribution of powers: **Union List, State List,** and **Concurrent List**.
 
• The** Union List** includes subjects on which** only the Parliament** can make laws.
 
• The **State List** includes subjects on which** only the** **State Legislatures** can make laws.
 
• The** Concurrent List** includes subjects on which **both the Parliament and State Legislatures** can make laws, but if there is a conflict, the **Union law prevails**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 79:**

 
 
• It establishes the **Parliament of India** as the **supreme legislative body** in the country.
 
• The Parliament consists of two houses: the Rajya Sabha (Council of States) and the Lok Sabha (House of the People).
 
• The President of India is also considered an integral part of Parliament.
 
• It outlines the composition, qualifications, and disqualifications for membership in both houses.
 
• It also mentions the powers and functions of Parliament, including law-making, budget approval, and oversight of the executive.**​**
 
 
 
• **Article 154:**
 
 
• **​**It establishes the **Governor as the executive head of a State** in India.
 
• The Governor is appointed by the President of India and holds office during the pleasure of the President.
 
• It outlines the qualifications, appointment process, and term of office for the Governor.
 
• The Governor acts as the constitutional head of the State and exercises executive powers on behalf of the President.
 
• The Governor has various functions, including summoning and proroguing the State Legislature and assenting to bills passed by the Legislature.
 
 
 
• **Article 280:**
 
 
• **​**It establishes the **Finance Commission of India**.
 
• The Finance Commission is a constitutional body that is responsible for recommending the distribution of financial resources between the Union and the States.
 
• It determines the principles governing grants-in-aid to States from the Consolidated Fund of India.
 
• The Commission is appointed every five years and consists of a Chairman and four other members.
 
• It submits its report to the President, who lays it before both houses of Parliament.
 
 

c4:T
